caption: The drawing features a large, rounded, tan ceramic jar with two handles on either side near the rim. The jar is adorned with a dark blue illustration of a bird standing on a branch on its side. Above and to the left of the jar, there is an inset showing the design of a single dark blue flower with several petals and two leaves on its stem, also rendered on a tan background. The handles of the jar are tinged with hints of blue. The composition is presented on a plain, off-white background bordered by two faint pencil-drawn rectangles. The artist's signature, "Yolande DeLasser," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
